claims.quote: Barnet welcomed the appearance of the atomic engine with the zest of masculine youth in all fresh machinery
claims.description: Vehicles and aircraft are powered by atomic engines.

claims.quote: ‘These new helicopters, we found,’ he notes, ‘had abolished all the danger and strain of sudden drops to which the old-time aeroplanes were liable’
claims.description: Helicopters replace fixed-wing aeroplanes for passenger flight and remove the danger of sudden drops.

claims.quote: London, under the Visible Smoke Law, by which any production of visible smoke with or without excuse was punishable by a fine
claims.description: A law fines any production of visible smoke, ending the sooty city.

claims.quote: the Rows, that ran along the front of the houses at the level of the first story, and, being joined by frequent bridges, gave the newer parts of London a curiously Venetian appearance
claims.description: Elevated pedestrian walkways run along building fronts at first-floor level, linked by bridges, separate from the roadway.

claims.quote: The insanitary horse and the plebeian bicycle had been banished from the roadway, which was now of a resilient, glass-like surface, spotlessly clean
claims.description: Roads are paved with a resilient, glass-like surface, and horses and bicycles are banned from them.

claims.quote: the men had struck that day against the use of an atomic riveter that would have doubled the individual efficiency and halved the number of steel workers
claims.description: An atomic-powered riveting tool doubles each worker's output and halves the number of steel workers needed.

claims.quote: the papers, which were printed upon thin sheets of metallic foil, were sold at determinate points by specially licensed purveyors
claims.description: Newspapers are printed on thin sheets of metal foil and sold by licensed vendors.

claims.quote: the police had power to challenge and demand the Labour Card of any indigent-looking person
claims.description: Police may demand a labor card from any poor-looking person and expel unemployed people from the main pavements.

claims.quote: since giving to wayfarers had been made a punishable offence there was no longer friendship or help for a man from the rare foot passenger or the wayside cottage
claims.description: Giving food or help to wayfarers is a punishable offence.

claims.quote: led to the appearance of what came to be called the ‘Modern State’ movement
claims.description: A popular movement arises demanding a state planned scientifically to rearrange social life, property and government.

claims.quote: This time it was talk of the Central European powers suddenly attacking the Slav Confederacy, with France and England going to the help of the Slavs.
claims.description: A European war breaks out between Central European powers and the Slavs, with France and England joining the Slavs.

claims.quote: I saw that we have still to discover government, that we have still to discover education, which is the necessary reciprocal of government
claims.description: Humanity will eventually develop a new science of government and education.
